title: Terms and Conditions

Transportation services are provided independently by registered auto drivers. OTOX provides the QR verification handshake, safety layer, digital trip record, and support ecosystem connecting passengers and drivers.

sections.heading: 3. User Conduct & Passenger Obligations

You agree to provide accurate phone verification details when initiating trip records.
Passengers agree to treat auto drivers with dignity, respect local traffic regulations, and pay the agreed street or meter fare directly to the driver.
Misuse of emergency buttons or false reporting of incidents will result in immediate suspension from the platform.

sections.heading: 4. Driver Partner Obligations

The OTOX QR sticker assigned to your vehicle is non-transferable and must remain clearly visible to passengers inside the vehicle.
Drivers must not allow unauthorized third parties to operate the vehicle under their verified OTOX identity.
Drivers agree to maintain safe driving standards and adhere to municipal transport fares and safety guidelines.
